description: This file contains language localization data for the CKEditor 4 plugin 'a11yhelp', specifically for the Croatian ('hr') language. It defines UI labels, tooltips, legends, navigation instructions, and other accessibility help content used within the editor's accessibility help dialogs.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: A method called on the CKEDITOR.plugins object to register localization data for a specific plugin and language.
